description: This file defines the ReportRepository class, which provides database access methods for reports, including retrieval by ID, project ID, templates, insertion, and deletion, using MySQL queries.

classes.name: ReportRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing report data in the database, with methods for CRUD operations and specific queries.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a report by its ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Fetches the latest 20 reports with associated project and attachment info.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new report record into the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a report by its ID.

methods.name: findByProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves reports associated with a specific project ID.

methods.name: findTemplates
methods.description: Fetches report templates with their attachments.
